description: Composable avatar-IP parameters. Options define visible design rules, never a fixed person's likeness.

soft-anime-tech-3d.label: Soft anime tech 3D

controls.material: soft polymer, vinyl optics, tactile fabric

soft-anime-tech-3d.prompt_block: Premium stylized 3D anime character with simplified nose and mouth, expressive but controlled eyes, clean rounded geometry, soft-polymer skin, tactile fabric, bright warm studio key, and a restrained colored rim; friendly and competent, not childish.

cute-collectible-3d.label: Cute collectible 3D
cute-collectible-3d.prompt_block: Cute premium 3D collectible character with a rounded iconic silhouette, simplified facial planes, plush-vinyl material separation, tactile fabric, clean seams, gentle studio light, and a polished designer-toy finish without infant cues.

q-chibi-3d.label: Q chibi 3D
q-chibi-3d.prompt_block: Q-version chibi 3D character with an oversized complete head, compact readable body, large expressive eyes, tiny simplified nose and mouth, rounded hands, bold clean silhouette, and soft toy-like material.

premium-toy-3d.label: Premium designer toy 3D

controls.material: satin vinyl, anodized hardware, tactile fabric

premium-toy-3d.prompt_block: Premium designer-toy 3D character with an iconic sculptural silhouette, simplified facial planes, satin vinyl, anodized hardware, tactile fabric, controlled translucent accents, and editorial product lighting.

semi-real-digital-human-3d.label: Semi-real digital human 3D

controls.material: refined PBR skin, hair, and fabric

semi-real-digital-human-3d.prompt_block: Semi-realistic 3D digital human with plausible anatomy, natural eye scale, softened facial proportions, refined PBR skin, hair, and fabric, subtle professional expression, and soft cinematic studio lighting without pore-level uncanny detail.

realistic-digital-human.label: Realistic digital human

controls.material: realistic skin, hair, eyes, and fabric

realistic-digital-human.prompt_block: Realistic but original digital human with anatomically coherent face and upper body, natural eye scale, believable skin, hair, eyes, and fabric, controlled studio lighting, and no resemblance to a real public figure.

balanced-stylized-upper-body.label: Balanced stylized upper body
balanced-stylized-upper-body.prompt_block: Use a consistent stylized upper-body construction: the complete head occupies 42–48% of visible character height, shoulders are 1.55–1.75 head-widths, the neck is short-to-medium, and the torso is compact but anatomically continuous.

cute-large-head-upper-body.label: Cute large-head upper body
cute-large-head-upper-body.prompt_block: Use a cute but coherent upper-body construction: the complete head occupies 50–56% of visible character height, eyes are 1.22–1.35 times natural scale, shoulders remain 1.45–1.65 head-widths, and the torso is compact without becoming infant-like.

q-chibi-upper-body.label: Q chibi upper body
q-chibi-upper-body.prompt_block: Use a coherent Q-chibi construction: the complete head occupies 58–66% of visible character height, with a very compact torso, short neck, rounded limbs, and deliberately simplified hands; keep the full crown visible.

semi-real-upper-body.label: Semi-real upper body
semi-real-upper-body.prompt_block: Use a semi-real upper-body construction with a complete head at 34–40% of visible height, natural eye scale, shoulders 1.75–2.05 head-widths, and plausible continuous neck, torso, and arms.

realistic-upper-body.label: Realistic upper body
realistic-upper-body.prompt_block: Use realistic adult upper-body proportions with a complete head at 30–36% of visible height, natural eye scale, shoulders 1.9–2.25 head-widths, and anatomically plausible neck, torso, and arms.

feminine-soft.label: Feminine, soft
feminine-soft.prompt_block: Use a softly feminine presentation through refined brow shape, restrained lashes, gentle facial styling, and poised expression only; do not infer hair length, chest shape, outfit, color, occupation, or personality.

feminine-tailored.label: Feminine, tailored
feminine-tailored.prompt_block: Use a confident tailored feminine presentation through clean brows, controlled lashes, crisp facial styling, and composed attitude only; anatomy, hair, clothing, and color follow their separate selected templates.

masculine-soft.label: Masculine, soft
masculine-soft.prompt_block: Use a softly masculine presentation through slightly denser brows, restrained lashes, calm facial styling, and grounded expression only; anatomy, hair, clothing, and color follow their separate selected templates.

masculine-structured.label: Masculine, structured
masculine-structured.prompt_block: Use a structured masculine presentation through clear brow construction, restrained lashes, subtly firmer facial planes, and confident neutral attitude only; do not infer chest, hair, clothing, or occupation.

androgynous-neutral.label: Androgynous neutral
androgynous-neutral.prompt_block: Use an androgynous presentation with balanced brow and lash treatment, neutral facial styling, and no gender-coded assumptions about anatomy, hair, outfit, color, or role.

custom.label: Custom presentation
custom.prompt_block: Follow only the project-specific gender-presentation description; do not infer unrequested anatomy, hair, clothing, color, or personality.

compact-neutral.label: Compact neutral
compact-neutral.prompt_block: Build a compact neutral torso with a quiet chest plane, balanced shoulders, short-to-medium neck, gentle torso taper, and clean crew-neck garment drape; do not emphasize sex-linked anatomy.

flat-straight.label: Flat chest, straight torso
flat-straight.prompt_block: Build a flat chest plane, straight torso sides, clean clavicle-to-shoulder transition, and a T-shirt that falls straight without bust contour or pinched waist.

soft-curved.label: Soft curved torso
soft-curved.prompt_block: Build a softly curved chest and torso with natural non-sexualized volume, balanced shoulders, a gentle waist transition, and fabric that follows the selected shape without exaggeration.

broad-athletic.label: Broad athletic torso
broad-athletic.prompt_block: Build broad level shoulders, a stable upper chest plane, slightly tapered athletic torso, proportionate neck, and relaxed garment drape without bodybuilding exaggeration.

soft-round.label: Soft round
soft-round.prompt_block: Use a soft round face contour with full cheeks, a short gentle jaw, and a rounded chin while preserving identity-specific eyes, nose, mouth, and skin.

tapered-oval.label: Tapered oval
tapered-oval.prompt_block: Use a tapered oval face with moderate cheek volume, a smooth narrowing jaw, and a softly defined chin while preserving identity-specific features.

rounded-square.label: Rounded square
rounded-square.prompt_block: Use a rounded-square face with a stable cheek-to-jaw width, softened corners, and a compact chin; keep it cute and graphic rather than angular or photoreal.

angular-soft.label: Soft angular
angular-soft.prompt_block: Use softly angular cheek and jaw planes with controlled definition and rounded transitions; preserve the selected stylization and avoid photoreal bone detail.

sculpted-bob-undercut.label: Sculpted bob with undercut
sculpted-bob-undercut.prompt_block: Hair is a sculpted asymmetric bob with a visible undercut, large clean strand groups, strong crown silhouette, face-framing fringe, and a fully visible top contour.

swept-taper.label: Swept taper
swept-taper.prompt_block: Hair has a swept textured top, clean tapered sides, controlled front fringe, and a complete crown silhouette built from a few readable sculpted groups.

cropped-coils.label: Cropped coils
cropped-coils.prompt_block: Hair forms compact cropped coils with a clear rounded crown, grouped curl clusters, controlled hairline, and simplified material suited to the selected 3D style.

rounded-crop.label: Rounded crop
rounded-crop.prompt_block: Hair is a compact rounded crop with an iconic outer silhouette, subtle front variation, clean side contour, and fully visible crown.

layered-shag.label: Layered shag
layered-shag.prompt_block: Hair uses layered sculpted locks, a broken outer silhouette, controlled volume at crown and sides, and face-framing pieces that never hide the eyes.

long-ponytail.label: Long ponytail
long-ponytail.prompt_block: Hair has a clean front silhouette and tied long ponytail with a readable root, tie, volume, and direction; keep the face and full crown unobstructed.

plain-base-tee.label: Neutral base T-shirt
plain-base-tee.prompt_block: Wear only a plain matte crew-neck T-shirt with short sleeves, no logo, trim, hardware, pattern, layers, jewelry, or fashion statement; it exists only to reveal shoulder, chest, neck, and torso construction.

signature-source-reconstruction.label: Reconstruct supplied signature look
signature-source-reconstruction.prompt_block: Reconstruct the supplied signature outfit and accessories exactly from the declared signature-look source, preserving silhouette, layers, neckline, sleeves, hem, hardware, material, and palette-area hierarchy; invent nothing.

neo-street-tech.label: Neo street-tech
neo-street-tech.prompt_block: Use a neo street-tech outfit with a cropped or compact outer layer, clean oversized volumes, technical strap or buckle logic, restrained utility hardware, tactile fabric, and one controlled electric accent; fashionable, not armored.

minimal-skate.label: Minimal skate
minimal-skate.prompt_block: Use a minimal skate-inspired outfit with relaxed boxy layers, clean jersey or canvas materials, one graphic-free color block, practical seams, and casual confidence.

y2k-playful.label: Y2K playful
y2k-playful.prompt_block: Use a playful Y2K-inspired outfit with compact layered shapes, glossy accent hardware, curved panel lines, and limited candy-color details while keeping the overall silhouette readable and premium.

smart-workwear.label: Smart workwear
smart-workwear.prompt_block: Use smart contemporary workwear with a short structured jacket or overshirt, simple inner layer, clean collar and cuff construction, restrained hardware, and approachable professional polish.

utility-tech.label: Utility tech
utility-tech.prompt_block: Use compact utility-tech clothing with functional paneling, one or two readable pockets, precise closures, soft technical fabric, and restrained hardware; keep the face and body silhouette dominant.

premium-casual.label: Premium casual
premium-casual.prompt_block: Use premium casual layers with a refined knit or jersey inner, softly structured outer layer, minimal seams, excellent fabric separation, and a calm editorial silhouette.

service-uniform.label: Service uniform
service-uniform.prompt_block: Use a friendly service uniform with a clear collar or neckline, simple role-readable panels, restrained piping, practical short outer layer, and no real-company marks.

none.label: None
none.prompt_block: No eyewear, visor, earpiece, jewelry, hair accessory, headset, or other wearable.

clear-ar-visor.label: Clear AR visor
clear-ar-visor.prompt_block: Add a slim transparent AR visor with exact bridge and temple contact, clear eyes and brows, controlled refraction, a narrow colored rim, and restrained outer bloom that does not tint skin or hair.

slim-glasses.label: Slim glasses
slim-glasses.prompt_block: Add slim lightweight glasses with a clean bridge, visible temples, correct face contact, low-reflection lenses, and unobstructed eyes.

mono-earpiece.label: Mono earpiece
mono-earpiece.prompt_block: Add one compact sculpted earpiece with believable ear contact, a clear housing and restrained light accent; keep it separate from the hair silhouette and do not add a headset band.

ear-jewelry.label: Ear jewelry
ear-jewelry.prompt_block: Add a restrained modular ear-jewelry set with clear attachment points, coherent metal/translucent material, and no interference with hair or face silhouette.

hair-clips.label: Hair clips
hair-clips.prompt_block: Add a small intentional set of geometric hair clips attached to visible hair masses, using the palette accent and consistent material; preserve the hair silhouette.

none.label: None
none.prompt_block: No held object, tool, device, package, icon, or floating prop.

analytics-tablet.label: Analytics tablet
analytics-tablet.prompt_block: Use one rigid tablet with a front glass plane facing the viewer; hands grip only side and lower bezels, the data surface stays readable, and the device never turns edge-on or hides the face.

communication-phone.label: Communication phone
communication-phone.prompt_block: Use one phone whose front glass faces the viewer; the holding palm stays behind the back shell, the thumb rests on the near bezel, and the free index may touch only the front glass.

workbench-laptop.label: Workbench laptop
workbench-laptop.prompt_block: Use one laptop with a vertical viewer-facing screen, one horizontal keyboard deck, and a visible hinge; one palm supports the deck and no screen appears on the outer lid or keyboard.

fulfillment-package-scanner.label: Package and scanner
fulfillment-package-scanner.prompt_block: Use one rigid package with a label fixed to one visible face and one compact scanner aimed at that label; hands support the box and scanner with believable contact.

campaign-megaphone.label: Campaign megaphone
campaign-megaphone.prompt_block: Use one compact megaphone with intact cone, rim, handle, and rear housing; the grip hand stays on the handle and the opening points away without covering the face.

cobalt-ultraviolet.label: Cobalt + ultraviolet
cobalt-ultraviolet.prompt_block: Apply color by material area: graphite dominant, cobalt secondary, ultraviolet accent, and a small electric-blue emissive detail; never tint skin, hair, eyes, or the entire image.

graphite-acid-lime.label: Graphite + acid lime
graphite-acid-lime.prompt_block: Use graphite dominant, cool-gray secondary, and acid-lime only as a small high-energy accent/emissive; preserve neutral skin and material color separation.

coral-cyan.label: Coral + cyan
coral-cyan.prompt_block: Use deep ink dominant, soft coral secondary, cyan accent, and minimal icy-cyan emission with clean warm/cool separation and no global grade.

warm-neutral-cobalt.label: Warm neutral + cobalt
warm-neutral-cobalt.prompt_block: Use warm gray dominant, cream secondary, and crisp cobalt accent in small areas; keep the result modern, calm, and material-led without global color cast.

silver-mono.label: Silver monochrome
silver-mono.prompt_block: Use charcoal dominant, controlled silver secondary, and small white highlights, separating materials by roughness rather than hue while preserving natural skin and hair color.

neutral-front-upper-body.label: Neutral front upper body
neutral-front-upper-body.prompt_block: Exact front-facing upper-body camera, zero head roll, level eye line and shoulders, full hair crown with 4–7% headroom, both shoulders and upper arms visible, centered torso, and lower crop at 94–98% of frame.

hero-three-quarter.label: Hero three-quarter
hero-three-quarter.prompt_block: Use a restrained 10–20 degree three-quarter hero camera with complete crown, readable face, subtle torso rotation, balanced headroom, and no dramatic lens distortion.

notification-crop.label: Notification crop
notification-crop.prompt_block: Use a compact front head-and-shoulders crop optimized for small notification size, with full crown, clear eyes and mouth, simple silhouette, and no identity-bearing feature near the edge.

full-body-turnaround.label: Full-body turnaround
full-body-turnaround.prompt_block: Use separate aligned front, side, and back full-body construction views with neutral stance, level camera, consistent scale, complete feet and crown, and no perspective drama.

dynamic-scene-upper-body.label: Dynamic scene upper body
dynamic-scene-upper-body.prompt_block: Use a locked upper-body scene camera with 10–25 degree torso rotation, readable face, complete crown, expressive but controlled gesture, and prop kept below identity-critical facial features.

concept.prompt_block: Create one clearly labeled character direction, not a production matrix. Show enough fashion and material language to judge the direction, with no role prop unless requested explicitly.

neutral-base.prompt_block: This is a neutral construction master. Wear only the forced plain base T-shirt. Use a neutral expression and relaxed arms. No final outfit, signature accessory, wearable, prop, action, scene, logo, text, or background decoration.

signature-look.prompt_block: This is a signature-look validation, not permission to expand the matrix. Preserve the approved identity and proportion exactly. If a signature source is declared, reconstruct it rather than inventing a new fashion concept.

complete-character.prompt_block: Create one complete reusable character from approved modules only. Preserve the approved identity, head scale, body construction, camera, and material; change no unselected axis.

scene.prompt_block: Create a scene subject from the approved complete character. Preserve identity and modules exactly; apply only the project-specific action and background contract, with believable hand/prop physics.
